budget_widget_description: Ukusetshenziswa kwemali kwanyanga zonke kanye nesabelomali esisele
section_income_vs_expense: Imali engenayo uma iqhathaniswa nezindleko (ideshi = isilinganiso)
averaged_across_months: Isilinganiso kuzo zonke izinyanga ze-%1$d ngomsebenzi.
share_sheet_help: Ivula ishidi lokwabelana le-Android ukuze ukwazi ukuthumela kunoma yiluphi uhlelo lokusebenza.
delete_transaction_message: Susa i-\"%1$s\"? Ungakwazi ukuhlehlisa lokhu ngemva kwalokho.
delete_budget_message: Susa umkhawulo wesabelomali we-\"%1$s\"? Ungakwazi ukuhlehlisa lokhu ngemva kwalokho.
view_only_mode_help: Uma kuvuliwe, okwenziwayo akukwazi ukwengezwa, ukuhlelwa, noma ukususwa. Vala noma nini kokuthi Izilungiselelo.
auto_lock_help: Khiya ngokuzenzakalelayo amarekhodi Omsebenzi amadala ukuze angakwazi ukuhlelwa noma asuswe. Usengakwazi ukuvula eyodwa ngesithonjana sokukhiya.
no_transactions_filter: Akukho okwenziwayo kulesi sihlungi sedethi. Thepha + ukuze wengeze eyodwa, noma usethe isampula yephrofayela kokuthi Izilungiselelo → Idatha.
budget_subtitle: Imikhawulo ye-%1$s nalapho kuhamba khona imali
budget_empty_help: Setha imikhawulo yanyanga zonke ngesigaba. Izibuyekezo zenqubekelaphambili ezivela ezindlekweni zenyanga yamanje.
forecast_negative_around: Ibhalansi ehlongozwayo ihamba kabi cishe ku-%1$s.
report_income_vs_expense: Imali engenayo uma iqhathaniswa nezindleko (izinyanga ezingu-6 ezedlule)
report_share_help: Ifaka unhlokweni wesifinyezo senyanga nakho konke okwenziwayo kwe-%1$s.
end_before_start_error: Idethi yokuphela kufanele ibe ngedethi yokuqala noma ngemva kwayo.
language_currency_preset_help: Ukushintsha ulimi kuphinde kusethe imali yasekhaya yale phrofayela ibe okuzenzakalelayo kwesifunda (%1$s). Ungashintsha uhlobo lwemali ngezansi noma nini.
exchange_rates_help: Faka noma iyiphi indlela — imali yasekhaya ngekhaya elingu-1 langaphandle, noma langaphandle ngekhaya elingu-1. Zombili izinkambu zihlala zixhumekile. Isetshenziswa uma umsebenzi ungolunye uhlobo lwemali.
fetch_live_rates_fail: Ayikwazanga ukulanda amanani abukhoma. Hlola uxhumo lwakho bese uyazama futhi.
budget_alerts_help: Thola isaziso uma isigaba sifinyelela ku-80%% yomkhawulo waso wenyanga noma sidlula.
date_filter_autohide_help: Goqa ama-chips esihlungi sedethi ngemva kwesikhathi sokungenzi lutho. Misa kokuthi Valiwe ukuze uwagcine evuliwe.
themes_subtitle: Khetha ukubukeka okufanelana nomoya wakho wemali
wallets_help: Landelela amabhalansi emali, iBhange, ne-E-Wallet. Nikeza isikhwama semali lapho wengeza okwenziwayo.
custom_expense_help: Engeza izigaba zakho zezindleko. Zivela kokuthi Okwenziwe kanye Nezabelomali, futhi zifakiwe kusipele/ukubuyisela.
custom_expense_empty: Azikho izinhlobo zangokwezifiso okwamanje. Izinhlobo ezakhelwe ngaphakathi (Ukudla, Ezokuthutha,...) zihlala zikhona.
profiles_help: I-Tracker yami idatha yakho yomuntu siqu. Setha isifanekiso sesampula njengephrofayela yaso, shintsha phakathi kwazo, noma susa isampula lapho ungasayidingi.
profile_delete_confirm_body: Lokhu kuyisusa unomphela i-\"%1$s\" nakho konke ukuthengiselana kwayo, ibhajethi, nezilungiselelo. I-Tracker yami ayithinteki.
msg_could_not_add_expense_type: Ayikwazanga ukwengeza uhlobo lwezindleko. Sebenzisa igama elingelona lutho elingekho ohlwini.
msg_backup_replaced: Ikhophi yasenqolobaneni yedatha engenisiwe futhi eshintshiwe kule phrofayela.\n\n%1$d okwenziwayo kubuyiselwe.
msg_backup_merged: Ikhophi yasenqolobaneni ingenisiwe futhi yahlanganiswa kule phrofayela.\n\n%1$d Imisebenzi yengeziwe.
recurring_empty: Akukho okwenziwayo okwenzekayo okwamanje. Vula i-\"Repeat monthly\" uma wengeza okwenziwayo ukuze udale eyodwa.
drive_help: Yenza isipele le phrofayela kufolda yohlelo lokusebenza oluyimfihlo ku-Google Drive yakho (engabonakali ku-Drive UI). Ukwenza ikhophi yasenqolobaneni nokubuyisela kuphela — akukho okuvunyelaniswa ngokuzenzakalelayo.
drive_setup_help: Idinga iklayenti le-Google Cloud OAuth Android ngephakheji com.financetracker.evolva (engeza ukulungisa iphutha/khipha i-SHA-1) nge-Drive API enikwe amandla kanye nobubanzi be-drive.appdata.
drive_restore_confirm_message: Lokhu kungena esikhundleni sayo yonke idatha ekuphrofayela esebenzayo ngesipele se-Drive. Ukuthunyelwa kwendawo kuqala uma ufuna ikhophi yokuphepha.
drive_no_cloud_backup_yet: Asikho isipele sefu sale phrofayela okwamanje.
drive_no_backup: Asikho isipele se-Drive esitholakele kule phrofayela
backup_help: Khipha ifayela eliyisipele ukuze ugcine ikhophi yedatha yakho noma uyithumele elungwini lomndeni. Ngenisa isipele ukuze uyibuyisele, noma uhlanganise idatha yomunye umuntu neyakho.
backup_help_profile: Izinto ezithunyelwa ngaphandle nezingeniswayo zisebenza kuphela kuphrofayela esebenzayo. Amanye amaphrofayili ashiywe angashintshiwe.
import_csv_help: Ukungenisa kwe-CSV kungeza imisebenzi kuphela (amakholomu afanayo njenge-Export CSV). Ukuhlanganisa kugcina imigqa ekhona; Shintshanisa imisebenzi yokusula kule phrofayela kuqala.
import_invalid: Lelo fayela alibukeki njengesipele se-Finance Tracker.
import_csv_invalid: Lelo fayela alibukeki njenge-Finance Tracker CSV ukuthumela ngaphandle.
msg_csv_merged: I-CSV ingenisiwe futhi yahlanganiswa kule phrofayela.\n\n%1$d okwenziwayo kwengeziwe.
msg_csv_replaced: I-CSV engenisiwe futhi yashintsha imisebenzi kule phrofayela.\n\n%1$d Imisebenzi ibuyiselwe.
app_password_set_help: Iphasiwedi yohlelo lokusebenza isethiwe. Iyadingeka ezenzweni zeNdawo Yengozi.
app_password_unset_help: Ayikho iphasiwedi yohlelo lokusebenza esethiwe (okuzenzakalelayo akunalutho). Ungasetha eyodwa ukuze ivikele izenzo ezibucayi.
danger_clear_help: Isula okwenziwayo kuphrofayela esebenzayo kuphela. Amabhajethi nemithetho evela njalo kule phrofayela iyagcinwa. Lokhu kudinga ukukhiya isikrini sedivayisi yakho kanye nephasiwedi yohlelo lwakho lokusebenza.
set_screen_lock_first: Setha ukukhiya isikrini kule divayisi kuqala.
about_tagline: Landela ngomkhondo imali engenayo, ukusetshenziswa kwemali, ibhajethi, nokonga kuwo wonke amaphrofayela — ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi kudivayisi yakho.
beta_expires_notice: Lokhu kwakhiwa kwe-beta kuphelelwa isikhathi ngomhla ka-31 Julayi 2027. Ngemva kwaleyo dethi uhlelo lokusebenza ngeke lusavuleka.
beta_expired_message: Le beta ye-Finance Tracker iphelelwe yisikhathi ngomhla ka-31 Julayi 2027 futhi ngeke isakwazi ukusetshenziswa. Sicela ufake ukukhishwa okusha uma kutholakala.
feature_profiles_desc: Gcina i-tracker yomuntu siqu kanye namaphrofayli oyisampula ongazikhethela ongawasetha, uwashintshe, noma uwasuse.
feature_currency_desc: Rekhoda ngezinhlobo zemali ezingama-30 ezinamanani axhumene aya phambili/aphambene kanye nokukhethwa kokulanda kwe-FX okubukhoma.
feature_wallets_desc: Landelela amabhalansi emali, ibhange, ne-e-wallet endaweni eyodwa.
feature_budgets_desc: Setha imikhawulo yesigaba futhi waziswe uma useduze noma ungaphezu kwesabelomali.
feature_transactions_desc: Engeza amanothi, izihlungi, izithombe ozikhethela zamarisidi, futhi uhlehlise ngemva kokususwa.
feature_recurring_desc: Thumela ngokuzenzakalelayo imali engenayo yanyanga zonke noma izikweletu ngaphandle kokuzifaka kabusha.
feature_reports_desc: Izifinyezo zanyanga zonke ezinombhalo, i-CSV, noma ukuthunyelwa kwe-PDF nokwabelana.
feature_security_desc: Vikela uhlelo lokusebenza ngephasiwedi kanye nokukhiya idivayisi lapho uhamba.
feature_widget_desc: Bona ukusetshenziswa kwemali kwale nyanga nesabelomali esisele ngokubuka okukodwa.
feature_languages_desc: Sebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza ngezilimi ezingu-25 ngezindikimba eziningi zokubukeka.
unlock_title: Faka iphasiwedi yohlelo lwakho lokusebenza ukuze uqhubeke
biometric_unlock_help: Uma ivuliwe, isikrini sokukhiya sinikeza izigxivizo zeminwe noma ukuvula ngobuso. Lokhu kuhlukene nenkinobho yephinikhodi/yephethini yedivayisi.
biometric_unavailable: Azikho izigxivizo zeminwe noma ukuvula ngobuso okusethiwe kule divayisi.
biometric_requires_password: Setha iphasiwedi yohlelo lokusebenza kuqala ukuze usebenzise ukuvula kwe-biometric.
tpl_student_desc: Izinyanga eziyisi-6 zemali engenayo yomfundi ejwayelekile, imali echithwayo, nokonga — 20+ okwenziwayo ngenyanga.
tpl_staff_desc: Izinyanga eziyisi-6 zemali engenayo, izikweletu nokonga okujwayelekile komsebenzi ohola iholo — 20+ okwenziwayo ngenyanga.
tpl_budget2026_desc: Imali engenayo ejwayelekile kanye nezindleko zansuku zonke zango-Jan–Jul 2026, kanye nesibonelo semikhawulo yesabelomali esifakiwe.
tpl_pro_desc: Izinyanga eziyi-19 zeholo elikhokhelwayo elikhokhelwayo, izikweletu, nezindleko kusuka ngoJanuwari 2025 kuya kuJulayi 2026, nemikhawulo yesabelomali sokuqala.
insight_empty: Engeza imali engenayo yokuqala, izindleko, noma imali engenisiwe ukuze ubone imininingwane lapha.
insight_avg: Ngokwesilinganiso uhola i-%1$s futhi usebenzise i-%2$s ngenyanga (kuzo zonke izinyanga ezingu-%3$d zedatha).
insight_biggest_expense: Isigaba sakho esikhulu sezindleko yi-%1$s ku-%2$s.
insight_spend_up: Ukusetshenziswa kwemali kwenyukile %1$s%% vs. ngenyanga edlule.
insight_spend_down: Ukusebenzisa imali kuphansi %1$s%% vs. ngenyanga edlule.
insight_net_negative: Usebenzisa imali engaphezu koyiholayo kulesi sikhathi — ibhalansi yonke ngu-%1$s.
insight_transfers: Uthumele u-%1$s futhi wamukela u-%2$s ekudluliseni nomndeni/abangane (konke %3$s).
insight_recurring: Unokuthenga okuphindayo kwe-%1$d okusethwe ukuze kuthunyelwe ngokuzenzakalela njalo ngenyanga.
insight_over_one: Udlule isabelomali ku-%1$s kule nyanga — %2$s kokungu-%3$s.
insight_over_many: Udlule isabelomali ezigabeni ezingu-%1$d kule nyanga: %2$s.
insight_near: Ususeduze nesabelomali sakho se-%1$s kule nyanga — %2$s kokungu-%3$s.
notif_channel_budget_desc: Izexwayiso uma isabelomali sesigaba siseduze noma singaphezu komkhawulo waso
